items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Later on I recorded some things for the Philo label, which was Norman Granz's early label... And I did some things for him.

ctx.x: [HEARTY LAUGH] Yeah... So that's how I really got started into the recording thing. Later on I recorded some things for the Philo label, which was Norman Granz's early label. That was short for Philharmonic, right after he had started the Jazz At The Philharmonic here in Los Angeles. And I did some things for him. I did some things for the Messner Brothers on their label; I don't remember the name of the label, but anyway...
